div.div:
Legend
3-line fork = many, single bar = one
PK = primary key, FK = links to another table
UQ = unique (no two rows may repeat it)
UQ* = unique among opening lines
UQ† = unique among live / closing lines
Dashed box = view (no rows of its own)
league is 'nba' or 'wnba', never defaulted
m = made, a = attempted, pct = made ÷ attempted
oreb / dreb = offensive / defensive rebounds
